Unofficial Android build of [GridCraft](https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft) — the real Rust engine and UI on Android tablets.

**Install:** download the `.apk` below, open it on the device, allow "Install unknown apps" if asked. Android 8.0+, arm64.
Verify: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Not affiliated with storytold / ArtCraft. See the [README](https://github.com/nideta231/gridcraft) for what's Android-specific and known limits.

**Updating:** the app checks this page on start and shows a banner when a newer release is out — tap **Download**, then install over the old one (same signing key, files and settings stay).
